'''July 2000 Vancouver tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Vancouver, BC, Canada on 1 July 2000. It is known from Ryan Mathison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d954">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vancouver-bc-canada-1-7-00d954/ vancouver-bc-canada-1-7-00], DeckTech (Ryan "Cradossk" Mathison, 1 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vancouver-bc-canada-1-7-00d954/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Vancouver, BC, Canada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 21
